## Summary
Provides temporal layer selection helpers for video forwarding. This generated index covers the selector interface and VP8 temporal layer selector implementation, with `null.go` intentionally excluded by request.

## Responsibilities
- Define the temporal layer selector contract.
- Select current and next temporal layers from packet metadata.
- Use VP8 payload descriptor information to avoid unsafe temporal layer switches.
- Coordinate temporal layer upswitch and downswitch decisions for forwarded packets.
